assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, design layers, figures, and drawings must be recalculated when trusted official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire safety, heritage controls, and engineering constraints are not available.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-specific statutory control, demolition, construction, investment, or engineering conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Desk Passes, Test Rooms, Adoption Orders, events, and community operations are conceptual governance and operating proposals.
assumptions.impact: They require willing operators, legal review, funding decisions, accessibility testing, and public participation before use.
